conventions.training_hits: Every-update first-hit counter; 0 means already met after intervention
conventions.evaluation_hits: Endpoint and post-repair observations only; no exact evaluation first-hit claim
conventions.scale_counts: Counts labels separately from branches; initial occupancy includes original and injected labels
conventions.failed_branches: Excluded from complete-case event claims; first-hit history can be censored by nonfinite termination
